body:
Machines Don’t Come With Confidence Built In

Machines don’t come with confidence built in. They come with levers, settings, and a whole lot of mystery.

Your Machine Can Do More Than You Think

When you first sit down at your machine, it can feel like it’s holding all the secrets. Every knob seems important. Every lever looks like a trap.

But the truth is simple: your machine can do far more than it's doing right now — and you don’t have to figure it out alone.

Removing the Guesswork

As Knit by Machine grows, I’m building tools designed to make your experience easier and more predictable. These include:

  • Calculators that handle the math for you.

  • Shaping helpers that guide you stitch by stitch.

  • Planning tools that turn ideas into clear steps.

  • Reassuring nudges that remind you, “don’t worry — this part is normal.”

WIFM: Spend More Time Knitting

The goal is simple: less frustration, more flow.

You get to spend more time knitting things you’re proud of — and far less time wondering why the carriage feels stiff or whether you’re using the right number of needles.

Tell Me What Feels Mysterious

What part of your machine feels confusing or unpredictable right now?

Your answer might become the next wizard — the next tool that makes things easier not just for you, but for every knitter who comes after.

— Sue
qaSection:
Questions knitters ask

Machine knitting involves unfamiliar levers, dials, and settings. Without guidance, it’s hard to know what’s normal and what’s not — which makes everything feel uncertain at the beginning.

KBM tools are designed to guide you step-by-step. Calculators handle the math, wizards walk you through shaping, and ANA entries answer the exact questions knitters ask every day.

Absolutely. Many KBM tools begin as real questions from knitters. If something feels confusing on your machine, chances are you're not the only one — and that makes it a perfect candidate for a new wizard.
